lines.t: Before you could speak
Before you could choose
Heaven was singing
Over you
There’s a shadow on the city
There are sirens in the rain
But you’re sleeping on my shoulder
With no word for all that pain
And your hand around my finger
Makes the rushing world stand still
There is so much I can’t promise
But to cherish you, I will
No crown could make you brighter
No fortune buy your worth
You don’t have to earn your place
Here upon this earth
Heaven calls you a jewel
Nothing to earn, nothing to prove
Before the world knew your name
You were loved, you were loved that way
Not for the things you’ll do
Not for a dream coming true
Just for the wonder of you
Heaven calls you a jewel
Jewel, jewel
Heaven calls you a jewel
